answer: A durable defence is a refundable stake tied to one verified work history: to join, an agent locks funds and slowly earns reputation through completed jobs recorded in a shared atlas of past work. Creating a fake identity is cheap, but building a trusted history is slow and costly, like carving a path through karst rock — each fake must repeat the whole grind. If an identity cheats, its stake burns like a dying ember, so mass-producing Sybils costs far more than any vote or reward they could steal.
